title_en: Sample entry: how a day will look
story_en:
This is a placeholder story. Each evening during the trip, this space will hold a few paragraphs about the day: where we went, what surprised us, and how it felt to see it together.

A blank line starts a new paragraph. Stories can be short or long; the page adapts on phones and large screens.

The photos below are generated placeholders. Tap any photo to open it full screen and swipe through the rest.
story_zh:

空一行即开始新的段落。故事可长可短，在手机和大屏幕上都能自适应显示。
